leads.name: Bella's Italian Kitchen
leads.hook: Opened 8 months ago with 67 Google reviews and growing — owner actively responds to every review but their menu PDF still shows the original launch design with no seasonal updates.
leads.email: Hi — I noticed Bella's has built a solid following since opening last fall (67 reviews is impressive for 8 months). Your menu on the website still shows the original launch version though. We help West Houston restaurants refresh menus and print promos without the downtown pricing. Worth a quick chat?

sendStrategy.timing: Tuesday morning between 9-10am before lunch rush
sendStrategy.followUp: If no reply in 3 days, call during off-peak hours (2-4pm) and mention the menu refresh observation

leads.name: Taco Libre West
leads.hook: Recent reviews mention 'prices went up' and 'portions smaller' — classic signal they're reinvesting and may need cost-effective print solutions for new promotional materials.
leads.email: Hey — saw a few recent reviews mentioning menu price changes at Taco Libre West. When restaurants adjust pricing, refreshed menus and table tents usually follow. We print locally in West Houston — faster and cheaper than going downtown. Happy to send a quick quote if useful.

sendStrategy.followUp: Drop off a sample printed menu with a handwritten note if no response after visit

leads.name: Harvest Table Bistro
leads.hook: 142 Google reviews with owner responding to reviews until 3 months ago — engagement dropped right when review velocity slowed, suggesting operational pressure and openness to vendor conversations.
leads.email: Hi — Harvest Table has great reviews (142!) but I noticed your seasonal menu hasn't been updated online since last spring. A lot of West Houston spots refresh menus this time of year. We handle design and print locally — one stop. Want me to send over what a spring menu refresh would look like?

sendStrategy.followUp: Follow up via Instagram DM with a photo of a similar restaurant menu we designed

leads.name: Pho Saigon Express
leads.hook: Opened 11 months ago, 89 reviews, basic one-page website with no online menu — strong indicator they need professional print materials to match their growing dine-in traffic.
leads.email: Hi — Pho Saigon Express is clearly doing well (89 reviews in under a year!). Your website doesn't have a menu posted yet though — we help new West Houston restaurants get professional menus, flyers, and takeout materials printed fast. First order includes free design. Interested?

sendStrategy.timing: Monday 2pm between lunch and dinner service
sendStrategy.followUp: Visit in person with printed sample menu mockup if phone call doesn't connect

leads.name: Cork & Barrel Wine Bar
leads.hook: Upscale wine bar with 156 reviews and $$$ price level on Google — high print budget potential, and their wine list PDF hasn't been updated since opening 2 years ago despite seasonal wine rotation mentions in reviews.
leads.email: Hello — Cork & Barrel's wine list online still shows your opening selection, but recent reviews mention new seasonal pours. We specialize in premium menu and wine list printing for West Houston restaurants. Would a refreshed wine list design be helpful this season?

sendStrategy.timing: Tuesday 10am — formal tone matches upscale positioning
sendStrategy.followUp: Send physical printed wine list sample via mail after 5 days with no response

leads.name: Smash Burger Co
leads.hook: Fast-casual spot with 203 reviews and slowing review velocity over the last 60 days — likely feeling competitive pressure in the crowded West Houston burger market and open to promotional print to drive traffic.
leads.email: Hey — Smash Burger Co has a loyal crowd (200+ reviews is no joke). With burger competition heating up on Westheimer, a targeted flyer or mailer campaign to nearby neighborhoods could bring in new faces. We print and mail locally — want to see what a campaign would cost?

sendStrategy.timing: Friday afternoon — casual tone fits brand
sendStrategy.followUp: Email with flyer mockup if DM goes unread after 48 hours
